title: An Optimal Analysis of the Product Test
summary: Product testing, i.e., deciding whether a pure multipartite quantum state is fully unentangled across a specified tensor decomposition, serves as a bridge between quantum property testing, unentangled quantum proof systems, and tensor optimization. Despite being a fundamental property testing task and having many applications, the product test's exact (worst-case) acceptance probability curve has yet to be fully determined.
